title: Lost & Found management
description: For one of the largest logistics companies in the world, we designed and built a system to manage lost and found parcels. This includes route optimization algorithms to calculate efficient picking routes and minimize employee travel within the warehouse. I lead the web frontend engineering team.
tech: Experimental multi window interface based on Window Management API
Early adoption of user-facing AI capabilities within the corporation, designed to accelerate and streamline the search for lost items.
Implemented keyboard-driven interactions and customizable shortcuts to streamline workflows and improve user efficiency.
